title: narcissus × montanus
intro: Narcissus × montanus, commonly known as the mountain narcissus or winter aconite, is a hybrid plant that combines the characteristics of narcissus and aconitum species. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus × montanus include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as aconitine, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although it's essential to note that the plant can be toxic in large quantities due to its aconitine content.
